title: Benchmarking Llama2, Mistral, Gemma and GPT for Factuality, Toxicity, Bias and Propensity for Hallucinations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model safety by measuring refusal rates to manually crafted red-teaming prompts (rt-inod-bias dataset) designed to elicit religious prejudice, utilizing a 'BEST-OF' metric (max of PREFIX-EXACT-MATCH and ROUGE-2) to detect appropriate refusal to answer.
